scripts.prebuild: npm run clean && mkdir -p dist/assets/css dist/assets/js dist/api dist/core dist/database
scripts.build: esbuild src/ts/app.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=dist/assets/js/main.js --sourcemap && cp src/css/styles.css dist/assets/css/ && cp src/index.html dist/ && cp server/api/*.php dist/api/ && cp server/core/*.php dist/core/ && cp -r database/customer.db dist/database/
